name: Demetrius
overview: Demetrius is a male figure mentioned in the New Testament who is noted for having received a good testimony from everyone, indicating a reputation of integrity and faithfulness within the early Christian community. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes recorded about him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Demetrius appears once in Scripture without an explicit meaning provided. It is a proper name of Greek origin, and no divine naming or special title is associated with it in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Demetrius beyond what is noted about his reputation. There are no listed relatives or connections to other biblical figures.
scriptureSignificance: Demetrius is significant in the biblical narrative as a commendable believer who earned a positive testimony from all who knew him, highlighting the importance of a good Christian witness in the early church.
